not-1429.name: British EBF Future Stayers Oath Novice Stakes
not-1429.conditions: 2yo · 5 runners · 1m 75y turf · Good, good to soft in places · winner £15,462
not-1429.verified_fact: Gainful was third of seven at Newmarket on debut and was the best of the newcomers. Top Scholar and Prince Of Petra are debutants with notable pedigree context.
not-1429.model_view: Gainful is the form anchor; Top Scholar is the pedigree/connections danger; Prince Of Petra is an unexposed pedigree watch. No probability or value claim is made without a calibrated model and live odds.
not-1429.market: No live odds/exchange feed is connected, so there is no steam/drift or value-gap claim.
not-1429.risks: Small sample sizes and debutants. Pedigree-history percentages and trainer debut statistics require a licensed historical feed.

kem-2000.name: Set Your Limits With Unibet Handicap (London Stayers Series Qualifier)

kem-2000.model_view: Now The Eagle is the Course Specialist. Last Flight is the Progressive/Class Test runner, Luan carries a Stamina Question, Vilaine Verlaine is a C&D Rebound Candidate and Desert Belle has a Consistent Profile.

kem-2000.risks: No sectional/pace feed and no live odds. Last Flight steps up in class; Luan's 2m stamina is unproven.
